director_findings: Adopt all nine independent-review ACCEPT decisions because each candidate has direct current MLIT 教則第5版 support and survived the full-336 canonical collision gate.
B14's pre-screen-before-authoring strategy materially improved yield relative to B13 and should be retained for later expansion batches.
C001 is a source-explicit VLOS exception boundary distinct from Q048's sustained monitor/assistant BVLOS proposition.
C002 and C003 add separate event-overflight decisions: live response to unexpected third-party/event conditions and the explicit 5 m/s cancellation threshold.

C004 and C005 test different conjunctive indirect-participant requirements than Q002; together with Q002 they reach the default same-core density ceiling of three, so no additional variant on that core is approved without explicit override.
C006 tests the Remote ID tether-exemption branch, distinct from Q030's flight-method tether exception and Q047's Remote ID special-area exemption.
C007 tests the actual Remote ID broadcast payload and the exclusion of owner/user information, which is not answer-defining elsewhere in the canonical bank.
C008 tests the priority of emergency-use airspace designation over ordinary airport/150m/DID permissions, distinct from Q041's sub-100g applicability rule.
C009 tests straight-line measurement geometry for the 30m rule, distinct from Q104's property classification.
